summary: Customer operates a petroleum stream, currently determines water content by sending samples to a laboratory, and wants to investigate a fiber based measurement closer to the process with the analyzer outside the process area. They explicitly ask what to clarify and what a first comparison experiment should establish before selecting equipment.
